answer_1.quote: We benchmark different architectures in terms of inference speed/translation quality trade‑off ... The contributions of this paper are: • A benchmark of two popular "light decoder" NMT architectures ... on two multilingual datasets (TED Talks and ParaCrawl) ...

answer_2.quote: We report average test BLEU scores ... We also compute the decoding speed in Words Per Second (WPS) ... We also report chrF scores and results on more models ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to compare the English‑centric Big 6‑6 and Big 12‑2 models. It is done by certified professionals who are proficient in both the source and target language. We use bilingual direct assessment (DA), where raters have to evaluate the adequacy and fluency of each translation on a 0‑5 scale given the source sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate adequacy and fluency of each translation on a 0‑5 scale.
